title.zh: Aave创始人：密切关注MetaMask质押事件，Aave市场未受影响
title.en: Aave创始人：密切关注MetaMask质押事件，Aave市场未受影响

current_state.zh: Aave founder Stani said his team is monitoring the MetaMask Staking infrastructure security incident alongside Lido, confirming that Aave markets are unaffected and all operations are running normally.
